channel.title: RateLog — Zed changelog
channel.description: Every pricing and usage-limit change RateLog has caught for Zed, dated and sourced — no other tools mixed in.

item.title: Zed — Moved from flat prompt limits to metered billing
item.description: [changed] Overhauled pricing from flat prompt-count limits to token-based billing. Pro dropped from $20/mo (500 prompts/month) to $10/mo, but the flat allowance was replaced with only $5/mo of included credit plus usage-based overage at API list price + 10%.
